# M3

> M3 is a three-month, salary-matched fellowship for senior security people
> moving into AI security. No mentors — fellows set their own direction.
> A collaboration between Constellation, Kairos and AISB (the AI Security
> Bootcamp team). Contact: fernando@m3fellowship.com

## The program

- Applications close Aug 14, 2026. Apply: https://airtable.com/apphv1q8pIb4a411d/pagICxIRB4MH1TmRA/form
- Week one: in person in London — research blocks, discussion sprints,
  field experts red-teaming project ideas.
- Build (weeks 2–5): remote, alongside the fellow's job, ~10 hrs/week,
  paid at the fellow's rate up to $100/hour.
- Demo day: Oct 3, 2026 — projects presented and routed onward (papers to
  workshops and arXiv referrals, tools to open source, new orgs to funders).
- Extension (months 2–3, by invitation): promising projects get two more
  financed months.
- Cohort size: 6 people.

## Who it is for

- The researcher: has a question the field has not answered.
- The founder: sees a gap worth an organisation.
- The field builder: wants to widen the door for others.

## Focus areas (suggestions, off-list welcome)

Compute governance, inference verification, model attestation, hardware
security, securing model weights, treaty verification, agent security,
authorization against misuse.
